bootstrap.unit: independent seed; refreshed support replicates averaged before contrasts

conditional.interpretation: Post hoc effort allocation on completed-cohort checkpoints; no promotion, proof of a deployable router, equivalence claim, or cue-subgroup rescue. A new policy requires separately locked fresh-data testing.

recurrent.interpretation: Post hoc effort allocation on completed-cohort checkpoints; no promotion, proof of a deployable router, equivalence claim, or cue-subgroup rescue. A new policy requires separately locked fresh-data testing.

limits: Saved-model intervention, not new training or prospective confirmation. Component-only predictions are ablations of a combined predictor; the residual is trained as a correction, not a standalone competitor. Refreshed support uses evaluator-supplied context, not autonomous context detection. Conditional crossed cells give an exact loss decomposition with interaction, not a unique causal cause of learning failure.

record_integrity.scope: Independent NumPy arithmetic, complete paired coverage, raw array/file hashes and equality with the copied historical full forecasts. Runner preservation and historical checkpoint binding are separate checks.
